faqs.a:
The city council hereby finds and declares that abandoned or inoperable vehicles left
               upon public or private property are detrimental to the public health, safety, and
               general welfare of the citizens and of the municipality. The city council also finds
               and declares that vehicles that may contain evidence or otherwise have evidentiary
               value and that are left upon public or private property are detrimental to the public
               health, safety, and general welfare of the citizens and of the municipality. The city
               council also hereby finds and declares that regulation of such vehicles on public
               or private property is necessary to ensure the general welfare of the people and is
               a permissible regulation of the aesthetics of the community.
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 4, 4-15-2013
;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
